cues.en: Hello, my friends, and welcome to this very, very important tutorial: the section cleanup.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到非常重要的教學，本節資源清理。

cues.en: In this tutorial, we're gonna clean up everything we created for this section, meaning all our SageMaker resources, but also all our S3 resources.
cues.zh: 會清理本節建立的全部資源，包括 SageMaker 與 S3。

cues.en: And just to do a complete cleanup, we'll delete the IAM roles as well, even though this doesn't incur any charges.
cues.zh: 為了完整，也會刪 IAM 角色，雖然角色本身不收費。

cues.en: Okay?
So let's do this.
Let's start with Amazon SageMaker AI.

cues.zh: 進入 SageMaker AI 主控台，找到 Domains。

cues.en: You can also find them here under Admin Configurations.
cues.zh: 也可以在 Admin configurations 下找到。

cues.en: And let's enter our domain, the one we created at the beginning of this section.
cues.zh: 進入本節開頭建立的網域。

cues.en: And here, the first thing we have to do to clean up everything is to go to User Profiles.
Unfortunately, you can't directly delete your user profile.
cues.zh: 可惜不能直接刪使用者設定檔。

cues.en: You have to delete the app first that you created and used, which is, of course, the Canvas app.
cues.zh: 必須先刪建立、使用的應用程式，當然是 Canvas。

cues.en: So let's go inside our user profile.
Then we're gonna scroll down to see the spaces and apps.
As you can see here: Spaces and apps.
And we see our Canvas app that we created and used.
cues.zh: 看到建立並使用過的 Canvas。

cues.en: And so, of course, we have to click Delete here to delete not only the Canvas app, but everything we did inside the Canvas app, which is why we don't have to go back
cues.zh: 當然按 Delete，講者表示不只刪 Canvas，也會刪掉裡面的工作，所以不必回到
